mapper.sql: SELECT a.*, (u.id IS NULL OR u.is_deleted = 1) AS authorDeleted, CASE WHEN u.id IS NULL OR u.is_deleted = 1 THEN '已注销用户' ELSE u.nickname END AS authorNickname, CASE WHEN u.id IS NULL OR u.is_deleted = 1 THEN NULL ELSE u.avatar END AS authorAvatar, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.name ORDER BY t.id SEPARATOR ',') FROM article_tag t WHERE t.article_id = a.id) AS tagNames, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM article_like al WHERE al.article_id = a.id AND al.user_id = #{currentUserId} ) AS likedByMe FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.author_id = u.id

sql.where:
a.status = 'published'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM article_tag t WHERE t.article_id = a.id AND t.name = #{tag})
AND ( (
a.id IN ( SELECT ft.id FROM article ft WHERE MATCH(ft.title, ft.content) AGAINST(#{fulltextKeyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) ) AND
(a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{likeKeyword}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{likeKeyword}, '%')) ) OR a.author_id IN ( SELECT su.id FROM user su WHERE su.is_deleted = 0 AND su.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{likeKeyword}, '%') ) )

mapper.select: WHERE a.status = 'published' ORDER BY a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC

ORDER BY a.last_comment_time DESC, a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC
ORDER BY a.like_count DESC, a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC
ORDER BY a.comment_count DESC, a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT t.name, COUNT(*) AS articleCount FROM article_tag t JOIN article a ON a.id = t.article_id WHERE a.status = 'published' GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY articleCount DESC, t.name LIMIT #{limit}
